scope: Retrospective qualification of the neutral-parent CCR5 tutorial, not independent validation
prior_exposure: All 75 public compounds and the historical 63/12 partition have already been inspected. None is a fresh external validation set.
reference_policy: Fewest heavy atoms, identifier tie-break; do not move supplied coordinates
interpretation: Existing score gates remain unchanged. Added bootstrap/stability criteria are declared engineering release checks, not universal QSAR validity standards. No replacement preset, seed, charge state or model is selected from these results. A passing retrospective diagnostic cannot establish prospective lead optimisation.
